name: Config Drift Crash
essence: The settings writer uses DB_URL while the reader expects DATABASE_URL and calls slice on undefined.

examples.summary: The settings writer uses DB_URL while the reader expects DATABASE_URL and calls slice on undefined.
examples.mechanism: The impure configuration function writes process-wide environment state under a key that the consumer no longer reads; the absent value is used as a string.
examples.observed_output: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'slice')
examples.expected_behavior: Use one agreed setting name and print database postgres.

ingredients.suggests: The configuration function changes the process environment instead of returning settings.
The writer and reader use incompatible environment-key conventions.

examples.summary: A configuration writer sets DB_URL but a consumer still reads DATABASE_URL and slices the missing value..
examples.mechanism: A configuration writer sets DB_URL but a consumer still reads DATABASE_URL and slices the missing value.

ingredients.suggests: The writer and reader use incompatible configuration-key conventions.

examples.summary: Configuration writes DB_URL while the reader slices the absent DATABASE_URL value.
examples.mechanism: Configuration writes DB_URL while the reader slices the absent DATABASE_URL value.

examples.expected_behavior: Read the same environment key written by configuration.

ingredients.suggests: Configuration changes the process environment as a side effect.

examples.summary: The reader fails because configuration writes the earlier key name.
examples.mechanism: Configuration mutates the process environment instead of returning settings. The consumer reads a different environment-key convention from the producer.
